---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: "[FEATURE]"
labels: feature, Triage
assignees: Simon0x

---

**What would you like to see?**
  A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement you'd like.

  **Use case**
  Describe how this feature would be used and what it would enable.

  **Affected components**
  - [ ] Event handlers
  - [ ] Configuration
  - [ ] Query API
  - [ ] Performance/indexing speed
  - [ ] Multi-chain support
  - [ ] Other: [specify]

  **Networks/chains involved**
  Which networks would benefit from this feature? [e.g. Ethereum, Polygon, all chains]

  **Describe alternatives you've considered**
  Alternative approaches or workarounds you've thought about (if any).

  **Additional context**
  Add any other context, code examples, or screenshots about the feature request here.
